summary: The task involved cleaning up PowerPoint captions with specific formatting requirements. The agent succeeded but used a brittle approach with multiple verification scripts that had to be iterated. Key lessons: python-pptx requires paragraph-level font access (not shape-level), position/sizing uses EMUs converted to inches, and some shapes throw NotImplementedError on shape_type. The skill captures the working pattern for formatting text boxes, identifies platform captions vs UI elements by text length and position, and provides reusable verification.
